claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Albuterol is a beta2-adrenergic receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since beta2 agonism produces cAMP-mediated vasodilation/bronchodilation and even at 100 uM causes only minimal apoptosis in cardiomyocytes.
